_about: Yugi's welcome. tour: said once, the first time you land on a run's timeline, as a tap-through conversation. screens: said once each, the first time you open that screen. Each line: key, mood, solo (and duo, if it differs) wordings, and target: a CSS selector for what to spotlight while it's up (comma-separated alternatives; the first one on screen wins). On phones, when the target is in the lower half of the screen, Yugi speaks from the top so he doesn't cover it. {set} is the run's current set, {packs} its packs per set, {rival} the rival's name. Lines stay under 140 characters.

tour.solo: Welcome, duelist! I'm Yugi. This is your road through the history of the game, one set at a time.
tour.duo: Welcome, duelist! I'm Yugi. You and {rival} will walk this road together, one set at a time.

tour.solo: We start at {set}, just like duelists did back then. Your deck can only use the cards you pull!
tour.duo: You both start at {set}, just like duelists did back then. Your decks can only use the cards you pull!

tour.solo: Each set, you open its {packs} packs once. Tap Open Packs when you're ready. The heart of the cards decides the rest!
tour.duo: Each set, you each open its {packs} packs once. You can't duel until {rival} has opened theirs too!

tour.solo: Then build a deck from what you pulled, and duel wherever you like to play. The Deck Builder can export it for you.
tour.duo: Then build a deck from what you pulled and duel {rival} wherever you two like to play. The Deck Builder can export it.

tour.solo: After the duel, come back and tap Record Match. Win or lose, the road moves on to the next set.
tour.duo: After the duel, one of you records it and the other confirms. Then the road moves on to the next set for you both.

tour.solo: A win spins the reward wheel, and a loss still gets you three pity packs. Every duel makes your collection stronger!
tour.duo: The winner spins the reward wheel, the loser gets three pity packs. Every duel makes you both stronger!

tour.solo: That's all there is to it! Let's open some packs.
tour.duo: That's all there is to it! Let's open some packs before {rival} beats us to it.

menu.solo: Hi, I'm Yugi! Start a run in Campaign Mode. Sign in if you want to take on a rival, or play as a guest on this device.

packs.solo: Here's this set's booster box! You can peek at the card list first, or open your packs right away.

haul.solo: That's your haul! Save it to add the cards to your collection. A set's packs only open once, so enjoy them.

collection.solo: Your binder! Every set gets its own chapter. Tap a card to read it, or search for anything you own.

deck-builder.solo: Build your deck from the cards you own: up to three of each. Aim for 40 cards in the main deck.
When it's ready, export it as a YDK file and load it wherever you duel. Good luck!

record-match.solo: Tell me how the duel went! Win or lose, we move on to the next set together.
record-match.duo: Tell me how it went against {rival}! They'll confirm it, and then we both move on.

rewards.solo: Your prizes wait here. Wins earn wheel spins, losses earn pity packs. Open them whenever you like!
A wildcard picks a card of its rarity or lower from the set you won it in. A Redoer Ticket rerolls a set's packs!
